purpose_context: Agent profiles declare operating procedures they run, but 36 of 50 point at nothing real and the graph ignores the field entirely — so the references are silently inert and their edges are hand-maintained one profile at a time. This mission makes every declaration resolve to a real procedure (loud on failure), triages the dead references, and teaches the graph to derive profile-to-procedure edges from the field so authored governance actually reaches the agent.
purpose_tldr: Make authored agent operating-procedures resolve to real doctrine, fail loud when they don't, and wire them into the doctrine graph automatically.
